cards.audioText: [Your call-sign is CES5227, from Wuhan to London Heathrow. Now you are at gate 26, information F, request your ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是东方5227，从武汉到伦敦希斯罗。你现在在26号机位，通播F，请求管制许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES5227, gate 26, information F, request ATC clearance to London Heathrow.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方5227，26号机位，通播F，请求飞往伦敦希斯罗的管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Delivery, you are cleared to your destination via flight planed route, runway in use 04, HZ-02D departure, initial climb to 600m, cruising level 10700m, squawk 3532, departure frequency 126.3.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 东方5227，武汉放行，你可以经由计划航路飞往目的地，使用跑道04，HZ-02D离场，初始爬升到600米，巡航高度10700米，应答机3532，离场频率126.3。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to destination via flight planed route, runway in use 04, HZ-02D departure, initial climb to 600m, cruising level 10700m, squawk 3532, departure frequency 126.3, CES5227.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往目的地，使用跑道04，HZ-02D离场，初始爬升到600米，巡航高度10700米，应答机3532，离场频率126.3，东方5227。

cards.audioText: [Contact Wuhan Ground and request your taxi clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【联系武汉地面，请求滑行许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES5227, request taxi instruction.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方5227，请求滑行指令。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Ground, taxi to holding point of runway 04 via A4, E2, hold short of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 东方5227，武汉地面，经由滑行道A4，E2滑行到跑道04外等待点，在跑道36右外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of runway 04 via A4, E2, hold short of runway 36R, CES5227.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道A4，E2滑行到跑道04外等待点，在跑道36右外等待，东方5227。

cards.audioText: [You are holding short of runway 36R on E2, request cross runway 36R, contact Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在跑道36右外等待点E2上，请求穿越跑道36右，联系塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5227, holding short of runway 36R on E2, request cross runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方5227，跑道36右外等待点E2上，请求穿越跑道36右。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Tower, roger, cleared to cross runway 36R, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 东方5227，武汉塔台，收到，可以穿越跑道36右，脱离后报。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to cross runway 36R, wilco, CES5227.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以穿越跑道36右，照办，东方5227。

cards.audioText: [You are at holding point of runway 04, request departure clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在跑道04外等待点，请求离场许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5227, holding point of runway 04, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方5227，跑道04外等待点，请求离场。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Tower, after airborne, fly runway heading to 600m, follow SID fly to HZ, when airborne contact 126.3, cleared for takeoff, runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 东方5227，武汉塔台，离地后，跑道航向上到600米，按照标准离场程序飞往HZ，离地后，联系126.3，可以起飞，跑道04。
cards.referenceText: Runway heading to 600m, follow SID fly to HZ, 126.3, cleared for takeoff, runway 04, CES5227.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道航向上到600米，按照标准离场程序飞往HZ，126.3， 可以起飞，跑道04，东方5227。

cards.audioText: [During climb, your trailing flaps cannot be fully retracted, contact Departure, state your situation and request fly to the holding area to perform checklist.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【爬升过程中，你的后襟翼不能完全收上，联系离场，说明你的情况并请求飞到等待区执行检查单。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CES5227, trailing flaps cannot be fully retracted, request fly to the holding area to perform checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，东方5227，后襟翼不能完全收上，请求飞到等待区执行检查单。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Departure, hold over LKO VOR 130 radial, inbound track 085, 30-40 miles legs, right hand pattern at 2700m.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 东方5227，武汉离场，在LKO台130度径向线等待，入航航迹085度，航段30-40海里，右等待，高度2700米。
cards.referenceText: Hold over LKO VOR 130 radial, inbound track 085, 30-40 miles legs, right hand pattern at 2700m, CES5227.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在LKO台130度径向线等待，入航航迹085度，航段30-40海里，右等待，高度2700米，东方5227。

cards.audioText: [After you finish the checklist, you cannot fix the flaps problem, you want to request another approach, inform Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在完成检查表后，你依然无法解决襟翼问题，你想申请再次进近，通知离场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CES5227, we cannot fix the flaps problem, request another approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，东方5227，我们无法解决襟翼问题，请求再次进近。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Departure, roger. Then fly heading 300, and this will vector you to join right hand downwind for runway 04. Contact Tower 118.025.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 东方5227，武汉离场，收到。航向300度，这将引导你加入跑道04右三边。联系塔台118.025。
cards.referenceText: Fly heading 300, to right hand downwind for runway 04, contact Tower 118.025, CES5227.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航向300度，加入跑道04右三边，联系塔台118.025，东方5227。

cards.audioText: [Because you can not fully extend the flaps, ask for the longest available runway from Tower controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【因为你不能完全展开襟翼，请向塔台管制员申请最长可用跑道。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5227, we can not fully extend the flaps, request the longest available runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方5227，我们无法完全展开襟翼，申请最长可用跑道。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Tower, roger. You are cleared to land on runway 04L, which is 3600 meters in length. Wind 030 at 8 knots, visibility 10 kilometers.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5227，武汉塔台，收到。你可以在跑道04左降落，跑道长3600米。风速030度，8节，能见度10公里。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land on runway 04L, CES5227.

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Tower. Continue your approach and report final.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 东方5227，武汉塔台，继续进近，五边后报。
